performance.networkBoundary: Thirty-eight fetch ERR_ABORTED records are retained. Their cause is not inferred; this is not a claim of zero network failures.
performance.measurementBoundary: Loopback static export, Windows Edge 1440x1000 DSF1, no CPU/network throttle. gzip is whole emitted-chunk calculation, not observed transfer. UI latency is handler-to-range observation; rAF intervals are callback intervals, not GPU frame times. No claim for physical phones or slow devices.

historicalPublicAcceptance.boundary: PR63 evidence is historical. Its WebKit first full-run failure and successful focused repeat retain their original statuses, not a full rerun.

boundaries: No final public deployment or public artifact acceptance. After deployment, same new public artifact must pass all121 cases in both Edge and WebKit plus independent visual acceptance.
Actual screenshot review is independent visual evidence; native motion/interaction comes from reviewed raw browser test evidence, not a claim that this reviewer personally operated the UI.
WebKit desktop/mobile emulation is not physical iPhone Safari acceptance. DSF2 is not actual browser UI zoom200%.
Root static/unit/preparation passes remain author-run evidence; this report does not recast them as reviewer executions.
Archived failed and interrupted runs are preserved as historical diagnostics; final passed evidence is named and hash-bound separately.
